citations.quote: Experience with Shorts, Reels or TikToks is not enough for this role.

constraints.text: The role requires editing capability specifically in long-form videos; experience with Shorts, Reels, or TikToks is insufficient.

prerequisites.text: Experience editing long-form YouTube videos is required.
Familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro is required.

citations.quote: You will receive a ready script, technical brief and references

steps.text: Review the provided script, technical brief, and references.

citations.quote: You will work closely with our producer, who will provide the brief, direction and feedback.

steps.text: Collaborate with the producer based on the given brief, direction, and feedback.

citations.quote: I don’t want someone who only follows instructions mechanically. I’m looking for someone who can think with the project.

steps.text: Think creatively regarding the project rather than following instructions mechanically.

citations.quote: I’m looking for a strong long-form YouTube video editor to join the team.
The role: 4 long-form YouTube videos per month Up to 20 minutes per video Adobe Premiere Pro only

summary.text: Olga Sinenko is seeking a strong long-form YouTube video editor for a remote, part-time role to create 4 long-form YouTube videos per month, each up to 20 minutes long, using Adobe Premiere Pro.
